title: Discovery protocol v2 live Learn run (reference V3.1 Actor, V4-Pro Explorer/Mechanic)
declared_by: Claude (Opus 5.5) as PM, delegated by the project owner

facts: This agent has no wait action; the clock advances only when it makes a business call.
Every HTTP attempt advances the clock 1 tick, including the automatic retry attempt.
It has at most 7 business calls: turn 8 is reserved for the final report.
The adapter makes at most 2 attempts per call, retrying after 429/5xx or a 1 s timeout, so a failure_count of 1 is absorbed before the agent sees it.
While an operation is pending it checks that operation's status once per turn until it finishes.

On its normal path it does not send a failed write again. If both attempts of a write fail, the status check says UNKNOWN; it then checks status at most 3 times (a failed check counts too) and stops, leaving the task unfinished.
caller.polling: one status check per turn while the operation is pending; at most 3 checks that return UNKNOWN or fail, and no re-send
caller.validated_against: the typical path of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1 under policy-v0, not other models: in a read-only back-test of stored completed development episodes, every modelled attempt seen in at least 10 of them was reached in at least 80% (scripts/experiments/check_reachability_caller.py)

primary: fully-fired discovery slots out of 8 (c701e850 baseline 4 of 8), computed by compute_primary.py; readings per PLAN.md section 9
stop_rules: PLAN.md section 7 (world-integrity failure, two consecutive LAB_ERROR, auth/config/frozen-model failure, discovery accounting anomaly: >144 requests / >.48 / >16 selections / >8 discovery episodes before REPRODUCING, source drift, <2 GiB disk, 6 hours; never restart, never replace, never reroll; if a source appears let the loop continue within 5c)
